## Summary

Describe the change and why it matters.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/release
- [ ] Refactor

## Verification

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run mypy src`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uv run python -m build`
- [ ] `uv run twine check dist/*`

## Notes

- [ ] I did not include credentials, production data, or secrets.
- [ ] User-facing docs or examples were updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests or a clear reason tests were not needed.
